description: This file defines models and a fetcher for the EIA Short Term Energy Outlook, including query parameters, data transformation, and data fetching logic with API interaction.

classes.name: EiaShortTermEnergyOutlookQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for the EIA Short Term Energy Outlook API, including options for symbol, table, and frequency.

classes.name: EiaShortTermEnergyOutlookData
classes.description: Data model for the EIA Short Term Energy Outlook data, with alias mappings for API response fields.

classes.name: EiaShortTermEnergyOutlookFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class that handles data extraction and transformation from the EIA API asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a strongly typed query parameter object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from the EIA API, handling pagination, errors, and response processing.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API response data into structured data models, with date parsing and categorization.
